## About
Tire Mart and Auto Express is a locally owned and operated shop in Livermore. Our ASE certified mechanics handle everything from oil changes and new tires to engine rebuilds, transmission repair and brake jobs, for all makes and models.
We've invested in modern diagnostic computers and repair tools so we can find the problem quickly and fix it right. We're glad to help our neighbors in Livermore, Dublin, Pleasanton and the towns around them. Se habla español.
If you've been in before, you've probably met Leo and Kevin. Give us a call for a quote or to schedule an estimate.

## Services
- Full service auto repair: Repair work on foreign and domestic cars, trucks and SUVs.
- Factory auto maintenance: Scheduled maintenance as an alternative to the dealership.
- Tire sales, repair and replacement: New tires, repairs and replacement for all makes and models.
- Engine and transmission repair: Bigger jobs too, from engine rebuilds to transmission repair.
- Brakes, suspension and steering: Brake jobs, inspections and steering and suspension work.
- Wheel alignments: Alignments to keep your car tracking straight and your tires wearing evenly.
- Auto AC service: Air conditioning service for your car or truck.
- Oil change and tune up: Routine oil changes and tune ups.

## FAQ
Q: Is Tire Mart mainly a tire store?
A: No. We sell and repair tires, but we also do full auto repair and maintenance, from oil changes to engine and transmission work.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Give us a call. We're happy to give you a quote or schedule an estimate.
